title: Mixed Bag
subject: General knowledge
blurb: A dozen from everywhere. The warm-up pack - nobody can claim it was rigged for their specialist subject.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.hint: Not the biggest city in the country, nor the second biggest - it was built as a compromise between the two.
questions.note: Chosen in 1908 precisely because Sydney and Melbourne could not agree.

questions.prompt: Which metal is liquid at room temperature?
questions.hint: It shares its name with a planet and a Roman god.
questions.note: Gallium is the near miss - it melts at about 30C, so it will melt in your hand but not on the table.

questions.hint: 52 of the keys are white and 36 are black.

questions.prompt: Which is the deepest ocean on Earth?
questions.hint: The Mariana Trench is in it.
questions.note: The Challenger Deep runs to about 10,900m - Everest would sit under it with a mile to spare.

questions.hint: He also drew a rather famous man in a circle.

questions.prompt: Which gas do plants absorb from the air?
questions.hint: Two words. You breathe it out.

questions.prompt: Which country gifted the Statue of Liberty to the United States?
questions.hint: The sculptor was Frederic Auguste Bartholdi, and Gustave Eiffel built the frame.
questions.note: A gift in 1886 marking a century of American independence.

questions.prompt: What is the hardest naturally occurring substance on Earth?
questions.hint: It is pure carbon, like the graphite in a pencil - the difference is only how the atoms are stacked.

questions.prompt: What is the largest animal on Earth?
questions.hint: Two words. Its heart alone weighs about as much as a small car.

questions.prompt: In which city would you find the Colosseum?
questions.hint: The stadium held something like 50,000 people, and the city still has the aqueducts that watered them.

questions.prompt: What is the longest river in Africa?
questions.hint: It runs north, which surprises people, and empties into the Mediterranean.

questions.prompt: Which Shakespeare play features the characters Rosencrantz and Guildenstern?
questions.hint: The pair were later given a play of their own by Tom Stoppard.
